| Table length | L | 0.25 m (x 0.20 to 0.45) | Largest rectangle inside the dexterous workspace along x; starts at x>=0.20 m to stay clear of the robot base |
| Table width | W | 0.50 m (y -0.35 to 0.15) | Same rectangle along y; every point can be grasped at any yaw |
